newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold prices rally on world market gains.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold prices rally on world market gains.

Indian 24 carat gold prices on Tuesday opened five rupees higher at 4,340 rupees per 10 grammes as a modest recovery in the world market and limited inflows helped local prices to bounce back in the early trade, dealers said:
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) opened 50 rupees higher at 50,750 rupees per piece after losing 200 rupees on Monday. They were down by 2,300 rupees last week.
Silver (.999) started 225 rupees lower at 6,180 rupees per kg on increased selling by local stockists following reports of plunging world markets.
Dealers said industrial buyers kept away in a falling market and sentiment was distinctly weak. Silver was down by 55 rupees per kg on Monday and by 240 rupees during last week.
